relationships.subject: delta opioid receptor
relationships.evidence_quote: Genetic downregulation of Oprd1 in DRG neurons reinstated pain hypersensitivity and cold avoidance in cisplatin-treated mice in both sexes (Figure 7a, b).

relationships.subject: IL-10
relationships.evidence_quote: Our findings indicate that tonic IL-10 signaling is critical to upregulate δOR antinociceptive activity to maintain remission and prevent relapsing pain.

key_findings: IL-10 from spinal meningeal border-associated macrophages signals via IL-10R1/STAT3 in DRG neurons to upregulate Oprd1 (δOR) and maintain pain remission.
Blocking IL-10 signaling, STAT3, or DRG δOR reinstated pain hypersensitivity; δOR overexpression rescued mechanical relapse.
